summary:
The separate existing-owner legacy continuation changes one already-owned PR body/title without admitting a reservation. It binds the complete native roster (at most20), exact current/default source and pushed-head ancestry, owning Delivery bodies, existing source marker and one closed native Root declaration. Adjacent REST/GraphQL identity, author/editor, current source, policy and preimage checks precede one possible-send record and PATCH. The stable native-PR custody address preserves prior operation history; uncertainty permits observation only. An explicit successor reconciles the exact prior intent/journal and native state before a later operation. Ordinary new-PR caps, exact-two adoption and SC2 remain unchanged.

Closed v2 adds canonical deliveryRepo and deliveryRepositoryId to every roster row. Same-organization repository/principal and exact native issue API/browser path, ID/body/open/Delivery joins apply to all owners, including the genuine Coordination roster whose closing-keywords Delivery lives in .github. Several PRs may share one owner; conflicting identities refuse. The v2 Root declaration on that actual owning issue also binds its repository/native identity and issue body hash. V1 retains its grammar and operation bytes. Both schemas share custody and explicit successor handling, so changing schema cannot evade uncertain history. The existing bounded opened-descriptor readers and canonical packaged rule/policy dependency closure remain intact.

Exact source has independent tests, v1 byte comparisons and causal guard mutations. Captured three-PR CLI replay uses explicitly inert authorization/source responses; it proves no real native continuation. The published0.117 predecessor and its acceptance remain separate from this additive v2 candidate. Normal protected integration, exact required CI, coherent publication, installed qualification and a genuine authorized native use/readback remain open. Source knowledge grants no dispatch, reservation release, deadline renewal, Game continuation or wholeDelivery acceptance.
title: Existing-owner continuation binds canonical cross-repository Delivery ownership and original custody
